name: Odagiri Harumichi
source:
The head of Odagiri family and a friend of Masashige.
He had been mastering the art of painting in France for several years, but suddenly returned home 8 months ago, shut himself in his estate and immersed himself in "something".
It is said that he has borrowed a lot of money from here and there.
